landing.badge: Nepal's Premier Doorstep Scrap Collection & Verified Income Platform
landing.heroDesc: Book free doorstep pickup in Kathmandu Valley. We weigh your recyclable scrap transparently on digital scales, pay you cash on the spot, and build official income records for collectors.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From clutter to cash in four simple steps
landing.howItWorksDesc: No haggling, no hauling it yourself, no hidden cuts. Just a clean, honest way to recycle and earn.
landing.step1Desc: Gather your paper, plastic, metal, glass and e-waste. A quick sort at home gets you the best rate.
landing.step2Desc: Choose a date and time slot on the app or website — or just call. Doorstep pickup is always free.
landing.step3Desc: A verified KabadMandu Saathi arrives and weighs everything on a calibrated digital scale in front of you.
landing.step4Desc: Cash in hand or a digital transfer via eSewa, Khalti or bank — the moment your scrap is weighed.
landing.liveRatesTitle: What we buy, and what it pays
landing.liveRatesDesc: Transparent estimates across every category. Final price is set on a digital scale at your door.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to turn your scrap into cash?
landing.ctaDesc: Book a free doorstep pickup today. Our verified Saathi weighs everything on a digital scale and pays you on the spot.

about.title: Formalizing Nepal's Informal Recycling Economy
about.desc: We are on a mission to connect households with local scrap collectors through transparency, fair calibrated pricing, and verifiable income records.
about.missionDesc: In Nepal, thousands of informal waste collectors earn honest daily incomes but cannot qualify for bank loans, microfinance, or credit because their work is unrecorded. KabadMandu logs every single transaction into a certified digital ledger, creating bank-ready income proof.
about.visionTitle: Zero Hassle Doorstep Recycling for Kathmandu
about.visionDesc: Instead of dumping plastics, metals, paper, and e-waste into municipality landfills, households can book doorstep collection with a few taps. Calibrated digital scales guarantee you get the exact fair market value for every kilogram.
about.value1Desc: Rates are updated dynamically based on real Nepal recycling market values. No middleman cuts.
about.value2Desc: Every collector on our platform is identity-verified and trained in polite doorstep service and digital scale handling.
about.value3Desc: Collectors unlock certified Building, Good, and Excellent trust tiers based on verified consistency and volume.
